    Home / About Us

    About Onuamo LLC

    Onuamo LLC was founded on a simple idea: everyday products should feel premium, without the premium price tag. We spend our time so you don't have to — testing categories, comparing suppliers, and hand-selecting the items that consistently earn five stars from real customers.

    What started as a small curated electronics shelf has grown into a full storefront spanning ten departments — from home and kitchen essentials to beauty, fitness, baby, pet, office, automotive and phone accessories. Every product on Onuamo is chosen because it solves a real problem well, not because it's trendy.

    Our Mission

    To make premium quality accessible. We believe good design and reliable performance shouldn't be reserved for luxury price points — they should be available to everyone, delivered quickly, and backed by support that actually helps.

    What We Stand For

    ✓

    Quality First

    Every product is vetted for durability, materials, and real-world performance before it earns a spot in our catalog.

    💬

    Honest Support

    Our team responds on live chat and WhatsApp — no chatbots pretending to be human, no runaround.

    🌍

    Built to Scale

    We ship across the US, Canada, UK, Australia and beyond, with local rates and realistic delivery windows.

    🔁

    Stand Behind It

    30-day returns and a straightforward refund policy — if it's not right, we'll make it right.

    Our Story

    Onuamo LLC is a privately held eCommerce company built by a small team of product researchers, designers and logistics specialists who were tired of guessing whether a product was actually good before it arrived at their door. Today, that same obsession with getting it right guides every listing you see on this site.

    Home / Privacy Policy

    Privacy Policy

    Last updated: January 2026

    Onuamo LLC ("Onuamo," "we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.

    1. Information We Collect

    We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, shipping address, phone number, and payment details when you create an account, place an order, subscribe to our newsletter, or contact customer support. We also automatically collect certain technical information, including your IP address, browser type, device information, and browsing behavior on our site through cookies and similar technologies.

    2. How We Use Your Information

    We use the information we collect to process and fulfill orders, communicate with you about your purchases, provide customer support, personalize your shopping experience, send marketing communications (with your consent), improve our website and product offerings, prevent fraud, and comply with legal obligations.

    3. Sharing Your Information

    We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information with trusted third-party service providers who help us operate our business — including payment processors, shipping carriers, and marketing platforms — solely for the purpose of providing services on our behalf. We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect our rights and safety.

    4. Cookies

    We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to remember your preferences, keep items in your cart, and understand how you use our site. You can control cookie settings through your browser, though disabling cookies may affect site functionality.

    5. Data Security

    We implement industry-standard security measures, including SSL encryption, to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

    6. Your Rights

    Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the use of your personal information, and to opt out of marketing communications at any time by clicking "unsubscribe" in any email or contacting us directly.

    7. Children's Privacy

    Our website is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

    8. Changes to This Policy

    We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last updated" date.

    9. Contact Us

    If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@onuamo.com or through our Contact Us page.

    Home / Terms & Conditions

    Terms & Conditions

    Last updated: January 2026

    Welcome to Onuamo LLC. By accessing or using our website, you agree to be bound by the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully before making a purchase.

    1. Use of Our Website

    You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of majority in your jurisdiction, to make a purchase on our website. You agree to provide accurate and complete information when creating an account or placing an order.

    2. Product Information & Pricing

    We strive to display accurate product descriptions, images, and pricing. However, errors may occasionally occur. We reserve the right to correct any pricing or listing errors and to cancel orders affected by such errors, with a full refund issued.

    3. Orders & Payment

    All orders are subject to acceptance and availability. Payment must be received in full before an order is processed, except where Cash on Delivery is offered. We accept major credit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Cash on Delivery in select regions.

    4. Shipping Policy

    Orders are typically processed and dispatched within 24–48 hours of purchase. Standard delivery times are 3–7 business days within the United States and 7–14 business days internationally, though actual delivery times may vary by carrier and destination. Shipping is free on orders over $49; otherwise, shipping fees are calculated at checkout based on destination and order weight. Once your order ships, you will receive a tracking number by email.

    5. Refund & Returns Policy

    We want you to be fully satisfied with your purchase. If you are not, you may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange, provided the item is unused, undamaged, and in its original packaging. To initiate a return, contact our support team via the Contact Us page with your order ID. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–10 business days of us receiving the returned item. Return shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer unless the item arrived damaged or defective, in which case Onuamo LLC will cover return shipping and provide a prepaid label. Certain items — including intimate personal care products, opened hygiene products, and final-sale clearance items — are not eligible for return.

    6. Intellectual Property

    All content on this website, including text, graphics, logos, and images, is the property of Onuamo LLC or its content suppliers and is protected by applicable intellectual property laws.

    7. Limitation of Liability

    Onuamo LLC shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our products or website, to the fullest extent permitted by law.

    8. Changes to These Terms

    We reserve the right to update these Terms & Conditions at any time. Continued use of our website after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

    9. Governing Law

    These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, USA, without regard to conflict of law principles.

    10. Contact Us

    Questions about these Terms & Conditions can be directed to legal@onuamo.com or through our Contact Us page.
